XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic noticeably reduced performance and/or immobilizer failure light on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0608 | P0120 | P0220 | PEDAL | THROTTLE | RESPONDS | PEDAL | IDLE | REMAINS | LOW | RPM | LOW | HIGH |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Accelerator pedal

  • Fault: Occasional lack of response from the accelerator pedal with the engine remaining at idle; intermittent high idle speed.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
  • P0608 (Injection control unit, speed signal 1 – Generic fault)

  • P0120 (Throttle position sensor / pedal / switch, section 1 – Generic fault)
  • P0220 (Throttle position sensor, section 2 – Generic fault)
  • Cause: Faulty accelerator pedal

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the accelerator pedal and replace it if necessary.
